# YouTube Hide Ads v1.0.0

## First public release

Removes YouTube ads and unwanted feed content, skips SponsorBlock segments, and adds fullscreen brightness/volume swipes and original-audio selection. Policy decisions are compiled Brainfuck; the host is a single XAX semantic store.

### Features

- Video, feed/search and shopping ads; sponsored Shorts removed before the pager is built.
- Premium, fullscreen and engagement-panel promotions.
- SponsorBlock: privacy-preserving hash-prefix lookup, guarded seeks; sponsor and self-promotion on by default.
- Playables, preview videos, Explore more topics and posts hidden by default; feed Shorts optional.
- Optional AI-channel filters (high and medium confidence AiSList lists).
- Fullscreen swipes: left edge brightness, right edge media volume.
- Prefers the original audio track on multi-language videos.
- Settings under **YouTube → You → Settings → YoutubeHideAds**.

### Changed since the last development build

- New package `io.github.mrxsin.youtubehideads` (was `org.youtubehideads.module`).
- Seven identical gate libraries merged into one `liband3.so`. The APK has 11 native libraries instead of 17 and is about 97 KB smaller. Behavior is unchanged.

### Verified

- Pixel 8 Pro, Android 17, YouTube 21.41.525, Vector 2.2 (libxposed API 102): all 531 startup self-checks pass and every hook installs. The installed APK matches the published SHA-256.
- Per-feature off/on UI checks were last run on development build 77 with the same policy bytes.

Other YouTube versions, devices and 32-bit/x86 ABIs are not certified. The APK is arm64-v8a only.

### Version metadata

- Version name: `1.0.0`
- Android version code: `100`
- Package: `io.github.mrxsin.youtubehideads`
- Git tag: `v1.0.0`
- APK filename: `YouTubeHideAds-v1.0.0.apk`
- APK SHA-256: `0c57a68a23baafc5a8b619bee3057ef7785c7d866853ebd45c4c81baa69ceb2b`

### Installing

Install the APK, enable **YoutubeHideAds** in Vector or LSPosed with `com.google.android.youtube` as the only scope, then force-stop and reopen YouTube. If a development build (`org.youtubehideads.module`) is installed, uninstall it first. Your settings are kept in YouTube's data.

# YouTube Hide Ads

Removes ads and unwanted feed content from the official YouTube Android app, skips SponsorBlock segments, and adds fullscreen brightness/volume swipes and original-audio selection. Each removal is authorized by a compiled Brainfuck policy. The host is a single XAX semantic store.

## Features

| Feature | Default |
| --- | --- |
| Video, feed/search and shopping ads | On |
| Sponsored Shorts, removed before the pager is built | On |
| Premium, fullscreen and engagement-panel promotions | On |
| SponsorBlock skipping (sponsor, self-promotion; other categories optional) | On |
| Playables shelves, cards and Explore entry | Hidden |
| Preview videos, Explore more topics, posts | Hidden |
| Shorts in feeds | Shown |
| AI channels, high and medium confidence ([AiSList](https://github.com/Override92/AiSList)) | Off |
| Fullscreen swipes: left brightness, right media volume | On |
| Prefer the original audio track | On |

Settings are under **YouTube → You → Settings → YoutubeHideAds**. Reload a feed after changing its switches.

## Scope

```text
com.google.android.youtube
```

Select **YouTube** as the module's only scope.

## Requirements

- A rooted arm64 device with a framework that implements libxposed API 102: [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector) or current [LSPosed](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed).
- Android 9 (API 28) or newer.
- The official YouTube app. Tested on 21.41.525.

## Installation

1. Install the APK from the release attached to this repository.
2. Enable **YoutubeHideAds** in the manager, with YouTube as its only scope.
3. Force-stop YouTube, then reopen it.
4. Log entries are tagged:

```text
YouTubeHideAds:
```

On a cold start the log reports the startup self-checks (531 in total) followed by `Hook installed` lines.

## Validation

Measured on a Pixel 8 Pro, Android 17, YouTube 21.41.525 and Vector 2.2. All 531 startup self-checks pass, every hook installs, and video ads, feed ads, sponsored Shorts and Playables are removed live. Premium, fullscreen and panel promotions passed controlled hook tests; naturally delivered positives remain unverified. Other YouTube versions and devices are not certified.

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | Suggested action |
| --- | --- |
| No module log entries | Check that the module is enabled with YouTube in scope, then force-stop YouTube. |
| `UnsatisfiedLinkError` right after an update | Let the update settle, then force-stop and reopen YouTube. The manager can briefly keep the old APK path. |
| A self-check reports `false` | The module will not act on that feature. Capture the `YouTubeHideAds:` log and open an issue. |
| A hook is missing after a YouTube update | YouTube changed an internal structure. Capture the log and open an issue. |

## Credits

| Project | Contribution |
| --- | --- |
| [DexKit](https://github.com/LuckyPray/DexKit) by LuckyPray | Structural discovery of obfuscated classes and methods. Apache-2.0. |
| [libxposed](https://github.com/libxposed/api), [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector) | Hooking API and framework. |
| [SponsorBlock](https://sponsor.ajay.app) | Community segment data, fetched through a privacy-preserving hash prefix. |
| [Override92/AiSList](https://github.com/Override92/AiSList) | Optional AI-channel lists, CC BY-NC 4.0; not bundled. |
| [Morphe Patches](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches) | Behavior reference; no implementation copied. |

## Disclaimer

Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Google LLC or YouTube. The module changes the app's behavior in memory on the user's own device and does not redistribute the YouTube APK. It contacts only SponsorBlock and, if enabled, the AiSList download. Provided for personal use. YouTube updates may break hooks without notice.
readmeZh:
# YouTube 隐藏广告

从官方 YouTube Android 应用程序中删除广告和不需要的提要内容，跳过 SponsorBlock 片段，并添加全屏亮度/音量滑动和原始音频选择。每次删除均由一份已编制的 Brainfuck 政策授权。主机是单个 XAX 语义存储。

## 特点

|特色 |默认 |
| ---| ---|
|视频、提要/搜索和购物广告 |上 |
|赞助 Shorts，在寻呼机构建之前被删除 |上 |
|高级、全屏和互动面板促销 |上 |
|赞助块跳过（赞助、自我推销；其他类别可选）|上 |
|可玩游戏架、卡片和探索条目 |隐藏|
|预览视频，探索更多主题、帖子 |隐藏|
|饲料中的短裤|显示|
| AI 通道，高和中置信度 ([AiSList](https://github.com/Override92/AiSList)) |关闭 |
|全屏滑动：左亮度，右媒体音量 |上 |
|更喜欢原音轨 |上 |

设置位于 **YouTube → 您 → 设置 → YoutubeHideAds**。更改开关后重新加载提要。

## 范围

````文本
com.google.android.youtube
````

选择 **YouTube** 作为模块的唯一范围。

## 要求

- 具有实现 libxpose API 102 框架的已 root 的 arm64 设备：[Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector) 或当前的 [LSPosed](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed)。
- Android 9 (API 28) 或更高版本。
- YouTube 官方应用程序。于 21.41.525 测试。

## 安装

1. 从附加到此存储库的版本安装 APK。
2. 在管理器中启用 **YoutubeHideAds**，YouTube 作为其唯一范围。
3. 强制停止 YouTube，然后重新打开。
4. 日志条目被标记：

````文本
YouTube隐藏广告：
````

冷启动时，日志会报告启动自检（总共 531 次），后跟“Hook located”行。

## 验证

在 Pixel 8 Pro、Android 17、YouTube 21.41.525 和 Vector 2.2 上测量。所有 531 家初创公司自检均已通过，每个挂钩均已安装，视频广告、信息流广告、赞助 Shorts 和可播放内容均已实时删除。高级、全屏和面板促销通过了受控挂钩测试；自然产生的阳性结果尚未得到验证。其他 YouTube 版本和设备未经过认证。

## 故障排除

|问题 |建议采取的行动 |
| ---| ---|
|没有模块日志条目 |检查该模块是否已在 YouTube 范围内启用，然后强制停止 YouTube。 |
|更新后立即出现“UnsatisfiedLinkError” |让更新稳定下来，然后强制停止并重新打开 YouTube。管理员可以暂时保留旧的 APK 路径。 |
|自检报告“错误” |该模块不会对该功能执行操作。捕获“YouTubeHideAds：”日志并提出问题。 |
| YouTube 更新后缺少一个挂钩 | YouTube 改变了内部结构。捕获日志并提出问题。 |

## 学分

|项目|贡献 |
| ---| ---|
| LuckyPray | [DexKit](https://github.com/LuckyPray/DexKit) |混淆类和方法的结构发现。阿帕奇-2.0。 |
| [libxpose](https://github.com/libxposed/api), [矢量](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector) | Hooking API 和框架。 |
| [SponsorBlock](https://sponsor.ajay.app) |社区分段数据，通过隐私保护哈希前缀获取。 |
| [Override92/AiSList](https://github.com/Override92/AiSList) |可选的AI频道列表，CC BY-NC 4.0；不捆绑。 |
| [Morphe 补丁](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches) |行为参考；没有复制实现。 |

## 免责声明

不隶属于 Google LLC 或 YouTube，也不受其认可或赞助。该模块会更改应用程序在用户自己设备上内存中的行为，并且不会重新分发 YouTube APK。它仅联系 SponsorBlock 以及 AiSList 下载（如果启用）。供个人使用。 YouTube 更新可能会破坏挂钩，恕不另行通知。
